items.title: Solana treasury DeFi Development authorizes CHAD preferred stock buyback program
items.summary: Solana treasury firm DeFi Development approved an open-ended program to repurchase CHAD preferred stock if it trades below its $10 par value.

items.title: Solana Debuts Institutional Settlement Standard With J.P. Morgan Input
items.summary: Built with input from J.P. Morgan, the open-source "DvP" program lets institutions settle trades atomically on Solana with finality in seconds instead of days.

items.title: Solana Foundation Launches Solana DvP, an Atomic Settlement Program Built for Financial Institutions
items.summary: Onchain open-source delivery-versus-payment infrastructure, tailored for the world’s leading financial institutions

items.title: DeFi Development Corp Adds $3 Million in Solana as SOL Buys Slow
items.summary: Nasdaq-listed DeFi Development Corp's latest SEC filing shows its Solana stash grew 1%, to about 2.56 million SOL and SOL equivalents—roughly half the prior week's gain and well below mid-September's pace.

items.title: DeFi Development sees NAV per share more than doubling, holds 2.56 million SOL
items.summary: DFDV says preliminary Q3 estimates show NAV per share more than doubled as its Solana treasury grew to 2.56 million SOL.

items.title: Solana x AI: The Democratization Layer
items.summary: Solana can give AI agents permissionless access to compute, training, identity, memory, and machine-native payments.

items.title: Open USD Is Live on Solana
items.summary: Open USD is live on Solana, letting businesses mint and burn 1:1 for dollars at no cost, with over $1 billion committed to liquidity.

items.title: Slot Time Reduction Effects
items.summary: Solana is now producing slots with a 250ms target, going down from 400ms. In this article we study the effects of this reduction based on direct on-chain measures.

items.title: Solana Foundation Appoints Rachel Conlan as Chief Strategy Officer and Jamal Raees as General Manager of Payments
items.summary: The Solana Foundation appointed Rachel Conlan to lead strategy and Jamal Raees to expand global payments adoption.

items.title: Stocks Go Onchain: What the SEC's Innovation Exemption Means for Solana
items.summary: A five-year SEC order lets tokenized shares with full rights trade on public blockchains without stock-exchange registration; Solana's architecture is live.

items.title: Agave 4.3 Update: All You Need to Know
items.summary: A roundup of the most important changes in the Solana Agave 4.3 validator client release, headlined by Alpenglow replacing TowerBFT with Votor.

items.title: Solana Changelog: September 18, 2026
items.summary: Transaction V1 reaches mainnet as Solana targets 250ms slots, lower rent, and program deployments with four times lower fees.

items.title: How AI Is Reshaping Crypto Security, with Michael Coates
items.summary: A ~$116 million Coldcard exploit shows why crypto security must eliminate single points of failure and automate defenses for AI-speed threats.

items.summary: Your Solana Events guide to thriving (and surviving) at Breakpoint London 2026
